Built **Karate Champion**, a complete playable 2D karate fighting game.

- Keyboard and mobile controls
- Health bars, rounds, timer, AI opponent, blocking, jumping, attacks, and special moves
- Victory and defeat screens
- Responsive dojo-themed presentation

Assumed a local arcade-style experience and browser-based controls.
